evidence.detail: 2026-10-09T21:36Z: ERROR: No matching distribution found for aspose-font

claim: At revision adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6, README.md line 539 instructs `pip install "aspose-font[mcp]"` and pyproject.toml declares the project name aspose-font, but PyPI has no distribution of that name (HTTP 404 and pip: No matching distribution found).
suggested_issue_title: Aspose.Font FOSS for Python: README says to run pip install "aspose-font[mcp]" but no such distribution exists on PyPI
suggested_issue_body:
Reproduced independently against the default-branch head `adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6` on 2026-10-09.

## Summary

The MCP Server section of the README (line 539) shows `pip install "aspose-font[mcp]"`. `pyproject.toml` declares `name = "aspose-font"`. PyPI has no such project, so the documented command fails. The README documents no other install path.

## Environment

- Revision `adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6` (default branch `main`)
- pip 26.2.1, Python 3.13

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://pypi.org/pypi/aspose-font/json
pip download aspose-font --no-deps
```

## Expected

The documented install command succeeds, or the README documents an install route that works.

## Actual result

```
404
ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement aspose-font (from versions: none)
ERROR: No matching distribution found for aspose-font
```

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:539`
- `pyproject.toml` line 6 (`name = "aspose-font"`)

## Evidence

- `https://pypi.org/pypi/aspose-font/json`: HTTP 404 on 2026-10-09T21:36Z (no distribution named aspose-font)
- `pip download aspose-font --no-deps`: 2026-10-09T21:36Z: ERROR: No matching distribution found for aspose-font
- `README.md`: line 539: pip install "aspose-font[mcp]" (revision adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6)
- `pyproject.toml`: line 6: name = "aspose-font"
